asset_purpose: leak-detective（水道の漏水調査員）のQ1イントロ画面の場所画像（place.image、375pxで幅いっぱい高さ210px、object-fit contain）と、猛暑イベントの6つ目のhotspot画像（丸くクロップ、imageFit: scene）。『深夜の住宅街で、地面の下の音を聴く』という場面を一目で伝える。ゲーム内の地図・弁・聴取点・計器はすべてClaudeがCSS/SVGで描くので、この画像は雰囲気と場所を伝える1枚だけ。
scene: A quiet Japanese residential street at night, seen from a slight top-down diorama angle. Warm street lamps, a few small houses with dark windows (one window faintly lit), a clean asphalt road with a manhole/valve lid at a corner. On the road surface, a small electronic leak detector: a compact box with a cable to a round pickup placed on the asphalt, and a pair of headphones resting beside it. A hand-drawn-feeling clay/miniature look. Calm, curious mood — 'something invisible is happening under this road'.
required_objects: night residential street with 2-4 small houses
asphalt road surface with a round valve/manhole lid at a corner
small electronic leak detector box with a cable and a round pickup placed on the road
interactive_object_visual_hierarchy: the detector pickup on the road (focal point, centre-lower third)
the valve lid at the corner (secondary)
what_must_be_visually_obvious: it is a normal residential road, nothing dramatic
a listening device is placed on the road surface
what_must_not_be_baked_into_image: any wet patch, puddle, spraying water, crack, or leak location (answer leak)
any highlighted or marked segment of road
a specific worker's face as a mascot
required_state_variations: none — a single static place image; success/failure states are rendered by the game UI (CSS/SVG), not by this asset
success_state: not baked into this asset (game UI shows the dawn: dry road, repaired patch, meter back to normal)
failure_state: not baked into this asset (game UI shows the refilled hole and still-damp road)
mobile_composition: 4:3, 1200x900. Keep the detector and valve lid within the centre 70% so a 210px-tall contain fit on 375px and a round hotspot crop both keep the subject; nothing important in the outer 8%.
clay_style_requirements: JIBUN CHOICE series style (factory/harness/art/style-contract.md): rounded 3D clay / miniature diorama, same material feel for houses, road, lamp and device, soft warm lighting even at night (blue-violet sky, warm lamp pools), no photorealism, no readable text, not childish, contemporary.
prohibited_mascot_invention: Do not invent a mascot or brand character. If a person appears at all, only a small back-view figure crouching by the detector, no face detail; preferably no person.
text_UI_separation: All text and UI (gauge, budgets, labels, report card) are rendered by the app. The image must contain no text or UI.
touch_affordance_requirements: None inside the image (the image is not interactive). The interactive map is drawn by the game component.
